title: Your first day at a new job or college
prompt: Describe your first day at a new job or college. Take us back to one moment from that day.
target_behavior: Include one sensory detail: a sound, a smell or something you saw.
tips: Pick one moment, not the whole day.
A specific detail beats 'it was overwhelming'.

feedback.headline: The target showed up in your answer — nice.

where.quote: Okay, so the short version: I help a team of twelve ship our app every two weeks.

what_worked: You kept it specific and easy to follow.
feedback.one_change: Try it once more and open with your main point.
